title: Remote access service exposed to the internet
detail: Inbound from WAN with source 'all' permits: RDP.
recommendation: Remove direct exposure; publish remote access through MFA-protected VPN/ZTNA and restrict sources.

title: Clear-text admin protocol on WAN interface
recommendation: Remove HTTP/Telnet from all interfaces; manage only from a dedicated management network.

title: Any-to-any accept rule
detail: Source, destination and service are all unrestricted.
recommendation: Replace with explicit source/destination objects and only the services required.

title: Any-to-any accept rule
detail: Source, destination and service are all unrestricted.
recommendation: Replace with explicit source/destination objects and only the services required.

title: Clear-text or high-risk service permitted
recommendation: Use encrypted alternatives (SSH, SFTP, HTTPS, SNMPv3) or tightly scope the rule.

title: Clear-text or high-risk service permitted
recommendation: Use encrypted alternatives (SSH, SFTP, HTTPS, SNMPv3) or tightly scope the rule.

title: Administrator without trusted hosts
detail: Admin account can log in from any source address.
recommendation: Set trusthost entries limited to the management network.

title: Logging disabled on accept rule
recommendation: Enable logging (all or utm) so allowed traffic can be investigated.

title: Internet-bound rule without security profiles
detail: No AV / web filter / IPS profiles applied to outbound traffic.
recommendation: Apply web filtering, application control, IPS and AV profiles as per policy.

title: Internet-bound rule without security profiles
detail: No AV / web filter / IPS profiles applied to outbound traffic.
recommendation: Apply web filtering, application control, IPS and AV profiles as per policy.

title: Temporary rule with permanent schedule
detail: Rule is labelled temporary but runs on schedule 'always'.
recommendation: Attach a one-time schedule with an expiry date or remove the rule.

title: Shadowed rule (never matches)
detail: Fully covered by earlier policy 1 (Staff-to-Internet); action here is 'accept', earlier action is 'accept'.
recommendation: Reorder or remove the rule; confirm intended behaviour with the rule owner.

title: Administrator without MFA
recommendation: Enable FortiToken / email / RADIUS-backed MFA for all administrators.

title: Rule has no name or comment
detail: Purpose and owner cannot be determined from the rulebase.
recommendation: Record purpose, owner, ticket reference and review date in the comment.

title: Disabled policy left in rulebase
detail: Policy is disabled but still present.
recommendation: Remove unused policies after confirming with the owner; keep the rulebase reviewable.

title: Long admin idle timeout
recommendation: Set admintimeout to 15 minutes or less.

title: HTTP admin not redirected to HTTPS
recommendation: Enable HTTPS redirect for the admin GUI.
